definitions.explanation: The period or condition following a surgical procedure. Used in medical contexts to describe recovery, complications, or care after an operation.

examples.japanese: {術後|じゅつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧だ。
{術後|じゅつご}{三日目|みっかめ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{歩行|ほこう}→歩行：21865_hokou⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Walking rehabilitation began on the third day after surgery.

examples.japanese: {術後|じゅつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{抗生|こうせい}{物質|ぶっしつ}→抗生物質：11089_kouseibusshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Antibiotics were administered to prevent post-operative infections.

notes:
USAGE:
{術後|じゅつご} is a medical term used by doctors, nurses, and patients when discussing recovery after surgery. It functions as both a noun and a prefix modifier. The opposite is ⟦{術前|じゅつぜん}→術前：26503_jutsuzen⟧ (pre-operative).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {術後|じゅつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧ (post-operative progress)
- {術後|じゅつご}⟦{合併症|がっぺいしょう}→合併症：12076_gappeishou⟧ (post-operative complications)
- {術後|じゅつご}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ (post-operative care)
- {術後|じゅつご}⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧ (post-surgical recovery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{術前|じゅつぜん}→術前：26503_jutsuzen⟧: pre-operative (antonym)
- {手術後|しゅじゅつご}: after surgery (full form, same meaning)
